questions.stem: Why are Data Strategy and Data Management treated together as one topic in I Am Datapedia!?
options: Because they are the same thing under two names
Because both are huge areas and the aim is to help readers understand the topics rather than train them
Because Data Management has replaced Data Strategy
Because neither is relevant to modern data solutions
Because they are only used in the banking sector
questions.explanation: The author planned two separate topics but combined them because both areas are huge and the book aims to build understanding rather than to train.

questions.stem: What is the relationship between Data Management and Data Strategy?
options: Data Strategy is a small part of Data Management
They are unrelated disciplines
Data Management replaces Data Strategy once a solution goes live
Data Management is one of the key elements of Data Strategy
Data Strategy is only concerned with hardware while Data Management covers software
questions.explanation: Data Management is described as one of the key elements of Data Strategy.

questions.stem: When are the features and capabilities of a Data Strategy defined?
options: Before the execution process starts
After the solution has been in production for a year
Only when a data quality problem is found
During the annual audit
After data governance has been set up
questions.explanation: Data Strategy is about defining all the features and capabilities before the execution process starts.

questions.stem: Which areas does Data Strategy cover?
options: Network topology, hardware and cabling
Payroll, recruitment and training
Only data architecture
Only tools and licences
Business strategy, organisational roles, data architecture and data management
questions.explanation: Data Strategy covers business strategy, organisational roles, data architecture and data management.

questions.stem: What are the goals of a Data Strategy?
options: To reduce headcount and cut IT budgets
To replace all on-premises systems with cloud services
To innovate, cater to business requirements and address risk and regulatory challenges
To archive as much historical data as possible
To standardise every report format
questions.explanation: Data Strategy goals are to innovate, cater to business requirements and address risk and regulatory challenges.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT listed as something Data Management maintains?
options: Marketing campaign budgets
Metadata
Data quality
Data security
Data governance
questions.explanation: Data Management maintains data architecture, datastores, metadata, data quality, data security, data integration, data transformations and data governance; marketing budgets are not among them.

questions.stem: What does Data Management make sure of once a solution is implemented?
options: That the solution is replaced every three years
That the solution is sold to other organisations
That the solution is moved to the cloud
That the solution is well maintained
That the solution is never changed
questions.explanation: Data Management makes sure that what is implemented as a solution is well maintained.

questions.stem: Which activities describe Data Management within an organisation?
options: Marketing, selling and invoicing data
Sourcing, processing, storing, organising and maintaining data
Encrypting, transmitting and deleting data
Auditing, fining and reporting data breaches
Designing, building and decommissioning hardware
questions.explanation: Data Management is about sourcing, processing, storing, organising and maintaining data within an organisation.

questions.stem: On what are the tools, processes and planning decisions of a Data Strategy based?
options: The preferences of the database vendor
The size of the IT department
Industry-wide default templates
The cost of cloud storage
Business or organisation requirements
questions.explanation: Data Strategy is about tools, processes, implementation planning and maintenance planning based on business or organisation requirements.

questions.stem: A Data Strategy ensures that an implemented data solution covers everything needed to do what with data?
options: Sell, license and export it
Encrypt, compress and delete it
Host, manage, protect, maintain and make use of it
Print, file and archive it
Sample, model and visualise it
questions.explanation: Data Strategy defines the elements needed so a data solution covers hosting, managing, protecting, maintaining and making use of data.
